_why: NEW-1 (B217540 recurrence x2). Budgets for ui-audit/perf-edit-cycle.mjs --assert, run at the default store weight (--store-kb 1300, the size of his 143-plan cloud account) on the owner's real plan. They are SLOPES and one worst-task ceiling, never a level, and they are set from the same harness measured on origin/main (red) and on the fix (green) so that main FAILS them and the fix PASSES with margin — see docs/perf/PERF-EDIT-CYCLE.md for the two runs. Not a CI gate: the runtime half of the perf budget stays on-demand by policy (docs/perf/PERF-BUDGETS.md — a shared runner's frame time flakes); the deterministic, CI-gated half is test/gestureSave.test.js + e2e/gesture-save-deferral.spec.js, which count writes instead of timing them.
